preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is a positive integer.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= n <= 10**6 and isinstance(n, int) for n in [int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::3]])
preconditions.description: For each test case, n is an integer between 2 and 10^6 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= m <= (n // 2) and isinstance(m, int) for n, m in [(int(line.split()[0]), int(line.split()[1])) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::3]])
preconditions.description: For each test case, m is an integer between 1 and floor(n/2) inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(a) == n and all(-10**9 <= x <= 10**9 and isinstance(x, int) for x in a) for a in [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines()[2::3]])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the array a has exactly n integers, each between -10^9 and 10^9 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(b) == m and all(1 <= x <= (n // 2) and isinstance(x, int) for x in b) for n, b in [(int(line.split()[0]), list(map(int, line.split()))) for line in zip(stdin.splitlines()[1::3], stdin.splitlines()[3::3])])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the set B has exactly m distinct positive integers, each between 1 and floor(n/2) inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(output, int) for output in [int(line) for line in stdout.splitlines()])
postconditions.description: Each output line is an integer representing the maximum possible sum of the array after any number of operations.

postconditions.expression: all(output == max(sum(a) + 2 * sum(a[i] for i in range(n) if a[i] < 0 and (n - i) in B or (i + 1) in B), sum(a)) for a, B, n in zip([list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines()[2::3]], [set(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines()[3::3]], [int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::3]]))
postconditions.description: The output for each test case is the maximum possible sum achievable by flipping intervals of sizes in B any number of times. The sum is maximized by flipping all negative elements that can be covered by intervals of size in B.
